0022600120.text: The Cavaliers (1-1, 3rd in the Central, 1 game back, 9th in the East) host the Timberwolves (2-0, 6th in the West), who have won both of their road games and enter on a two-game winning streak. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and Cleveland won their last meeting 146-134 at home on January 10, 2026.
